caption_L1: This area diagram is named Number of Grammy Awards categories from 1959 to 2021. The y-axis measures Number of categories as linear scale from 0 to 100 while the x-axis plots Year along linear scale with a minimum of 1960 and a maximum of 2020.
caption_L2L3: We can see clearly from this graph that from 1960-2010 there was a very steady increase In aware catorgories, then in 2010 there was obviously an event or decision that had been made that changed this and from 2010 there was a significant drop down to about 80 catagories from the previous 100+, over the more recent years 2010-2020 there has been a slow increase but this is nowhere near the peak just before 2010.
